$comment: Evaluation thresholds that skill_eval.py reads at import (the module constants keep their names, types and values). Each value: value, type (the Python type: a JSON list becomes a tuple when type is tuple), source (skill-creator, agentskills.io, or house) and note.

LAYERS.note: Grading layers of an assertion; no source note in skill_eval.py. Same values as eva.py EVAL_LAYERS and the evals.schema.json layer enum.

PRIMARY.note: Name of the configuration with the skill; no source note in skill_eval.py.

DEFAULT_RUNS.note: Runs per case and configuration; no source note in skill_eval.py.

TRIGGER_THRESHOLD.note: skill-creator run_eval.py --trigger-threshold default; agentskills.io: 0.5 is a reasonable default.

TRIGGER_POS.note: House rule (H): exactly 10 should-trigger queries; skill-creator and agentskills.io say 8-10 each. trigger-evals.schema.json x-count-where uses the same bound.

TRIGGER_NEG.note: House rule (H): exactly 10 should-not queries; skill-creator and agentskills.io say 8-10 each. trigger-evals.schema.json x-count-where uses the same bound.

HIGH_VARIANCE_STDDEV.note: H: per-eval pass_rate stddev that gets a flaky note.
